offering_description.value: Digital Turbine helps app developers and advertisers acquire users and helps mobile publishers monetize their apps. It distributes apps through software integrated into Android devices by wireless carriers and device manufacturers, and runs a programmatic marketplace for in-app advertising.

primary_products.value: on-device app discovery and installation software; programmatic ad exchange; in-app ad mediation software

primary_services.value: mobile app distribution; user acquisition campaigns; in-app ad placement; publisher ad monetization

customer_segment.value: B2B: Mobile app developers, advertisers, ad agencies, app publishers, wireless carriers and device manufacturers

end_markets.value: mobile apps; mobile gaming; digital advertising; wireless telecommunications; mobile devices

revenue_model.value: advertising: App promotion campaigns and in-app ad placements, commonly priced by installs, impressions or other measurable results

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Connects app developers and advertisers with device placements and in-app inventory supplied by carriers, manufacturers and publishers; service provider: Runs app promotion and user acquisition campaigns for developers and advertisers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: On-device app distribution, mobile user acquisition and in-app advertising monetization

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Wireless carriers and device manufacturers integrate app discovery and installation software into Android devices; direct sales: Sales teams work with app developers, advertisers, agencies and publishers; online: Ad buyers and app publishers connect through programmatic integrations and publisher software development kits

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Mobile ad targeting and measurement are subject to data privacy and consent rules such as GDPR and California’s CCPA
